title: Trump reportedly puts DNI Clayton in charge of US cybersecurity until a National Cyber Director is confirmed
date_note: Page dates the order to 23 November (US time), citing CNBC.
org: White House / Office of the Director of National Intelligence
summary: Fnnews, citing CNBC and a White House official, reports that President Trump directed Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to oversee US cybersecurity on an interim basis. The National Cyber Director nominee is awaiting Senate confirmation. Fnnews lists recent outages at Microsoft, JPMorgan, United Airlines and the NSA's internal classified network, and a nationwide halt to aircraft takeoffs, without giving causes.
plain: Korean outlet Fnnews, citing CNBC, says Trump has asked intelligence chief Jay Clayton to oversee US cybersecurity for now while the cyber director nominee awaits Senate confirmation.
exec: Fnnews reports an interim change in who oversees US cybersecurity; the original CNBC report was not read.

validation.note: Only Fnnews read; it relays CNBC citing a White House official. CNBC and the White House were not read.
